mapper.sql: e.evidence_id, e.owner_type, e.owner_id, e.original_name, e.stored_path, e.file_size, e.content_type, e.uploaded_by, u.user_name AS uploader_name, e.uploaded_at, e.deleted_yn, e.deleted_by, e.deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM evidence e LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = e.uploaded_by WHERE e.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND e.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY e.evidence_id
SELECT FROM evidence e LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = e.uploaded_by WHERE e.evidence_id = #{evidenceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evidence (owner_type, owner_id, original_name, stored_path, file_size, content_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted_yn) VALUES (#{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{originalName}, #{storedPath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploadedBy}, #{uploadedAt}, 'N')
